jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied AI Engineer based in Netherlands. As an Applied AI Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing and building the next generation of intelligent, agentic systems. You will develop the core infrastructure that enables AI agents to manage context, use tools, coordinate tasks, and continuously improve their performance. Working at the intersection of advanced AI research and practical software engineering, you will transform complex operational workflows into reliable, scalable production solutions. You will establish robust evaluation, testing, and observability frameworks to ensure AI-powered systems deliver predictable and measurable results. You will also explore innovative ways to integrate coding agents and specialized subagents into software development processes. Collaborating closely with product and operational teams, you will identify high-impact automation opportunities and translate them into effective technical solutions. As an early core member of the engineering team, you will have significant influence over architectural decisions, technical standards, and the long-term AI strategy. Accountabilities In this role, you will design and implement the technical foundations of agentic systems while driving the adoption of AI-powered engineering workflows. Your responsibilities will include: Design and build essential components of agentic systems, including memory, context management, tool-calling capabilities, orchestration mechanisms, and feedback loops. Develop reusable AI infrastructure that enables new workflows to be introduced quickly, consistently, and with predictable reliability. Build comprehensive evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance, identify failure points, and understand the factors behind successful outcomes. Integrate testing, tracing, debugging, and evaluation into the software engineering lifecycle as fundamental practices. Develop systems and validation processes that allow agentic workflows to be thoroughly assessed before production deployment. Advance the use of large language models (LLMs) in software development by creating sophisticated AI-assisted engineering workflows. Build workflows where coding agents and specialized subagents can explore code repositories, implement changes, review architecture, validate conventions, run evaluations, and iterate with minimal human intervention. Actively use agentic engineering tools and workflows in daily development activities. Design architectures that enable specialized AI agents, tools, deterministic software, and human expertise to work together effectively. Determine when to use LLMs, traditional software solutions, human intervention, or coordinated multi-agent approaches to achieve the best outcomes. Collaborate with operational and product teams to understand existing processes, identify high-value automation opportunities, and transform them into reliable production systems. Establish scalable architectural patterns and engineering standards for agentic systems as the organization grows. jobs.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity. We want you as a talented Software Functional System Verification & Validation Engineer to help us in our mission by making sure that Nyx's flight software does exactly what the system needs it to do, and that this is proven at the right level of test. Key Responsibilities In your capacity as a Software Functional System V&V Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include: Keep a holistic view of the system-level software functional requirements and ensure they are correctly implemented and verified. Decide, per requirement, the right verification level: low-level unit test, SIL scenario, PIL run, HIL run, or vehicle-in-the-loop run. Define, plan, and execute verification campaigns across these levels, and analyse and report the results. Work day to day with the functional chain responsible in each subsystem team to define functional chains, test cases, and required test facilities. Dive into the details when needed: analyse failures in the code and make hands-on adjustments to test scripts, test harnesses, and software, in coordination with the FSW team. Maintain traceability from system requirements to implementation and verification evidence. Review test descriptions, expected inputs and outputs, and verification reports for completeness and correctness. Triage test failures, drive issue resolution with the FSW team, and manage related deviations and waivers. Prepare test readiness and review material, and report verification status to the FSW lead and the Chief Engineer. What we would love to see from you In the role of Software Functional System V&V Engineer, ideally you will have the following: What we would love to see from you Degree in Aerospace, Software, Electrical, or Computer Engineering, or a related field. 5-10 years of experience working on complex space projects, including software verification and validation of embedded, real-time, or safety-critical systems. Hands-on experience with at least two of: SIL, PIL, HIL, or vehicle-level test campaigns. Holistic system thinker who is also ready to go into the code and make adjustments when the details require it. Strong C/C++ reading and debugging skills, plus scripting for test automation (e.g., Python). Solid understanding of spacecraft subsystems and how functional chains span them (e.g., AOCS, power, thermal, propulsion, avionics). Experience with requirements management and traceability tools. Structured, precise, and ownership-driven, with the ability to align multiple subsystem teams. Clear written and verbal communication in English. Nice to have Experience in flight software on spacecraft or launch vehicles. Familiarity with NASA & ECSS standards for space software and verification. Experience operating or setting up SIL, PIL, HIL and/or vehicle-in-the-loop facilities. Why you should join us! jobs.description: Medical Data Intern (x/f/m) Set a new pulse for healthcare! We are looking for a Medical Data Intern to join the Terminology and Ontology team within the Medical Excellence department at Doctolib in Berlin . At Doctolib, we're setting a new pulse for healthcare. We create AI-powered solutions that help health professionals focus on care and help people prevent, detect, and treat health problems earlier. In this role, you will contribute to making medical information clear, structured, and usable across products for patients, healthcare professionals, and technical teams. What you'll do Your responsibilities include but are not limited to: Collect and format sets of terms describing pathologies, allergies, treatments, and other medical concepts, based on standard medical terminologies such as ICD-10 and SNOMED CT. Adapt medical labels to create versions that are understandable to patients and healthcare professionals. Translate labels from English into German. Map medical lists of terms across different products. Select and filter terms, then validate your choices with medical experts. Share your work and methodology with the Terminology and Ontology team and product teams. Deliver sets of terms to technical teams in the correct format. About our data environment Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to the country and healthcare specialty requirements. Our stack is composed of Dagster, dbt, Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, and other technologies. We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here and learn about our first AI hackathon here ! If you would like to find out more about tech life at Doctolib, feel free to read our latest Medium blog articles ! Who you are Before you read on, if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply. You could be our next teammate if: You have medical skills gained through a diploma or degree that includes medical-domain learning. You have knowledge of data management. You are familiar with medical terminologies such as ICD-10 and SNOMED CT. You have strong spreadsheet skills, including Google Sheets or Excel and the use of formulas. You are attentive to detail and demonstrate rigour in your work. You speak German and English, which is a must have for this role. Nice to have: Experience using AI tools such as Claude. Python programming skills. Additional depth of medical knowledge. Dutch language skills. What we offer A structured and personalized onboarding program through our Doctolib Academy , as well as a wide range of in-house training opportunities and masterclasses throughout the internship. Regular breakfast in the office and subsidies for your lunch or grocery shopping . A Deutschlandticket sponsored by Doctolib, or reimbursement of your semester ticket . A flexible workplace policy offering up to 2 days of hybrid work per week. The interview process An interview with our Talent Partner (30 minutes). An interview with the hiring manager (30 minutes). We welcome applications from all candidates, regardless of gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability. jobs.title: Senior / Staff Engineer (Routing & Optimisation)
jobs.description: About HIVED 📦 At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing. Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery. A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better. Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market. Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures , Maersk Growth , Pale Blue Dot VC , Eka Ventures , NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery. Role Overview 📝 We're looking for a Senior or Staff Engineer to take on some of the hardest problems at HIVED: the planning systems that decide how every parcel moves through our 100% electric delivery network. You'll join the Routing Squad , which owns HIVED's entire planning pipeline: demand forecasting, capacity planning and scheduling, sortation, our collections network and large-scale route optimisation. Most of the work is backend engineering on distributed, production-grade systems, built in close partnership with data scientists, analysts and our operations teams. If your depth is in operations research or machine learning and you want to see your models plan a real delivery network every day, we'd love to hear from you too. This is a hands-on role with a lot of technical ownership. You'll shape how the pieces of the pipeline fit together and your work shows up in the routes our drivers take, the cages filled at our depots and the parcels that arrive on time. The problems are as varied as they are hard. How much volume will each depot see next week, and how many drivers and vehicles do we need to meet it? How should parcels flow through sortation and our collections network so nothing is handled twice? How do we turn each day's parcels into routes that are efficient, reliable and on time? And how do we model the cost and geography of our network as we expand into new cities? What You'll be Doing 🚀 Build the planning pipeline. Design, build and run the distributed systems behind routing, capacity planning, sortation and our collections network. Turn ambiguity into designs. Take complex operational problems, break them down, and see them through from first investigation to production. Shape the architecture. Shape how the planning pipeline fits together, and coordinate with other squads where our systems meet theirs. Put models into production. Build and productionise optimisation, forecasting and ML models, making them robust, observable and ready for peak volumes. Stay close to the operation. Work directly with operations teams, see how plans perform on the ground, and close the loop with data. Raise the bar. Lead design and code reviews, mentor engineers, and set the standards for testing and reliability. What We're Looking For 🔎 Typically 5+ years of software engineering experience, building and operating production systems. A track record of technical ownership beyond your own work: you've shaped the architecture or direction of systems spanning multiple components or teams. The ability to translate complex, ambiguous operational problems

All in-depot day-to-day and planning activities including people (labour pool, engagement, leadership succession planning), safety (auditing and near miss/incident reporting), quality (SLA, set-off/on-time dispatch), and cost (labour planning D+1/W+1/TPH). What we’re looking for 🔎 4-8 years’ experience leading fast-paced dispatch / middle-mile operations. Strong command of driver operations, route execution, and dispatch accuracy. Role Overview 📝 The Fleet Coordinator owns the day-to-day control, inspection, and performance of the vehicle fleet, ensuring vehicles are safe, available, compliant, and cost-controlled. The role is responsible for early detection of damage and risk, fast recovery of repair costs, and close coordination with Maintenance and Operations to protect vehicle uptime and service reliability. This is a hands-on, depot-based role critical to operational continuity and cost discipline. What you’ll be doing 🚀 Ensure all vehicles are inspected, logged, and controlled to agreed standards. Carry out basic repairs where possible and collaborate with local garage for more complex repairs. Coordinate repairs and servicing with Fleet Maintenance to minimise downtime. Coordinate On the Road Breakdown with Fleet Maintenance/Third Party Partners to minimise downtime. Protect fleet uptime through early issue identification and prioritisation. Monitor driver behaviour and escalate safety or performance risks. Ensure key management processes followed & regularly audit keys. Ensure full compliance with health & safety and fleet standards. Produce clear fleet performance insights and improvement actions. What we’re looking for 🔎 1-3 years’ experience operating in operational roles or vehicle-related roles. Experience of working with vehicles - uptime, light repairs, vehicle inspections, maintenance & servicing. High urgency, strong communication, strong escalation habits. Our Values 😊 We Are Kind - Kind to the planet, our team and our partners. We listen with purpose, leave our egos at the door and aren't afraid to make difficult decisions. We must never confuse kindness with being "nice" - it requires us to be fair, consistent, honest, thoughtful and compassionate. 🤝 We Are Tenacious - We fight every day to keep the customer promise, for every parcel entrusted to us. jobs.description: Founding Product Engineer London · £120K–£200K plus equity · Visa sponsorship available The Mission We are replacing the Management Consulting industry with software. The $1 trillion consulting industry is powered by some of the world’s brightest minds, yet they remain trapped in manual, inefficient workflows: spreadsheet orchestration, slide-deck assembly, and fragmented data synthesis. We proved it on ourselves first. Our advisory business serves six private equity funds across the UK, Europe and the US, and one Riplo consultant delivers an engagement that a tier-one firm staffs with a full team. The platform we built behind that work is now open to the world. Next, we are running the same playbook on a much bigger market: AI transformations for PE funds and the companies they own. Our team comes from QuantumBlack/McKinsey, BCG, DeepMind, Hg Capital and KKR. Cherry Ventures, Blue Lion and the founders of QuantumBlack back us, with angels from OpenAI, McKinsey, BCG and Apple. We are nine people, and we are hiring one Founding Product Engineer. The Challenge As our Founding Product Engineer, your role is not just “writing code”. You will report directly to our CTO, and define the product DNA of the company. You will: Build Beyond the Chatbot: Design multi-step agentic workflows that move past simple RAG and produce analysis a PE fund pays for. Make Quality Measurable: “Good enough for a partner” is a hard standard to code against. Build the evals, harnesses and review checks that prove an agent’s output meets it. Turn Evidence into Insight: Connect research, data and sources to the final page, so that every claim on a slide traces back to its evidence. Work Directly with Our Clients: Build AI use cases inside client organisations, alongside the people who use them. What you learn there shapes the core roadmap. Pioneer the Agentic SDLC: Agents write most of our code. Design the systems, steer the agents, and push our own way of building software forward with a very large token budget. You Are a Fit If: You are a Product Builder: You might be a product engineer at a SaaS company, a product manager who now ships code, or a consultant building serious AI tooling on the side. We judge purely on the quality of what you have built. You don’t need a 20-page PRD. You can take a vague user pain point from a client and ship a functional prototype by Friday. You value Speed: You believe that in an early-stage startup, iteration velocity is the only unfair advantage. You prefer shipping a 90% solution today over a perfect one next month. You are “T-Shaped”: You hold deep experience in one area (product management, management consulting, or front-end engineering), but are comfortable enough with the others to add value across the business. Our Stack Product: TypeScript, Next.js, React, Tailwind Data and Infra: PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS, Terraform Real-time: Collaboration over WebSockets Why Join Us? Real Ownership: £120K to £200K base salary plus equity. You will own a piece of the company you are building, and you will own the product roadmap with the CTO. High Trust / Low Bureaucracy: We value clarity of thought and bias to action. No middle management, no pointless meetings, just building. The Practicalities: London-based, four days a week in the office, one flexible day, and client site time when projects require it. Visa sponsorship available. Vous justifiez d'une expérience pratique en institut, spa ou établissement de bien-être. Vous êtes autonome dans la réalisation de vos soins, rigoureuse, organisée et attentive aux détails. Vous êtes sensible à l'univers du bien-être haut de gamme et aux soins personnalisés. Les conditions Contrat : CDI à temps partiel – 20 heures par semaine. Disponibilité : le samedi indispensable, complété par des heures en semaine. Planning : jours et horaires en semaine à définir ensemble selon vos disponibilités et les besoins de la maison. Lieu : Paris 15e, métro Boucicaut. Rémunération : selon profil et expérience. Prise de poste : dès que possible. Pourquoi rejoindre LE SONGE ? Parce que nous sommes convaincues qu'une praticienne épanouie est aussi une praticienne qui prend mieux soin des autres. Nous avons à cœur de proposer un environnement de travail agréable, respectueux et équilibré. Vous rejoindrez une maison à taille humaine qui privilégie le savoir-faire, l'écoute et la qualité plutôt que les soins standardisés. Un lieu où chaque détail compte et où l'on prend soin des personnes autant que de leur bien-être. Rejoindre LE SONGE, c'est notamment bénéficier de : Un temps de transition de 30 minutes entre les soins, pour préparer les cabines et accueillir chaque cliente dans les meilleures conditions. Une attention particulière portée au rythme de travail, avec un nombre de soins par jour et par praticienne adapté, afin de préserver la qualité des prestations et le bien-être de l'équipe. Un cadre de travail soigné, chaleureux et qualitatif. Une salle de repos spacieuse et agréable, pour que chacune puisse profiter de véritables temps de pause. Une perspective d'évolution : LE SONGE est une maison en plein développement, avec de beaux projets pour les années à venir. Nous souhaitons construire une équipe stable et durable. Le poste pourra évoluer progressivement en fonction du développ

jobs.title: System Performance Intern
jobs.description: About Pangea Propulsion: We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems. Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade. We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology. We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry. We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse. We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team! We are looking for a System Performance Intern in Toulouse . About the role: We are seeking a motivated System Performance Intern to join our System Performance team in Toulouse. During this six-month internship, you will support system-level design, modelling and performance analysis activities for Kronos full-flow staged-combustion rocket engines. You will work closely with System Performance engineers and specialists in combustion, fluidics, turbomachinery and other disciplines to connect engine requirements and design choices with cycle modelling, subsystem characteristics and overall engine performance. You will be involved in the development and execution of engine models, investigating nominal, throttled and off-nominal operating conditions, and assessing how evolving subsystem designs influence the complete propulsion system. The work will include sensitivity studies, design trade-offs and support to the definition of operating and control strategies. This internship requires strong fundamentals in thermodynamics and fluid mechanics, an understanding of liquid rocket-engine cycles, and the ability to interpret numerical results critically rather than treating simulation tools as black boxes. You will contribute to transient analyses covering start-up, throttling and shutdown, and consolidate results into engineering conclusions, performance maps, operating envelopes, subsystem requirements and technical documentation for design reviews. Key Responsibilities: · Develop, modify and execute system-level engine models in EcosimPro/ESPSS. · Analyse nominal operating points and engine operational envelopes, including throttled and off-nominal conditions. · Support engine-cycle optimisation and system-level design trade-offs. · Perform sensitivity studies on key design and operational parameters. · Translate simulation results into engineering conclusions, performance maps, operating envelopes and subsystem requirements. · Support preparation and maintenance of System Performance documentation for project design reviews. · Work with combustion, fluidics, turbomachinery and other disciplines to integrate evolving subsystem designs into the system model. What you need to be successful: · MSc in Aerospace Engineering or equivalent, preferably with a background in propulsion, fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, energy systems or numerical modelling. · Experience with numerical modelling and engineering analysis through academic or professional projects. · Strong fundamentals in thermodynamics, fluid mechanics and heat transfer. · Understanding of liquid rocket propulsion and the fundamental operation of rocket-engine cycles. · Ability to analyse coupled engineerin

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: Want to take ownership of large-scale infrastructure, solve complex technical challenges, and shape the future of our platforms? Join Hornetsecurity's Service Reliability (SR) team and help power cybersecurity services used by customers worldwide. Our infrastructure processes over 200 million emails and scans more than 100 million websites every day, running on 4,000+ servers and 300+ Kubernetes nodes. As we continue to grow and evolve following Vade's integration into Hornetsecurity and Hornetsecurity's acquisition by Proofpoint, you'll have the opportunity to modernize business-critical systems, build new platforms, and influence technical decisions in a complex, high-availability environment. This isn't just about keeping systems running. You'll take end-to-end ownership of platforms, from architecture and automation to production operations and continuous improvement. Your Job Own and shape platforms: Design, build, and operate reliable, scalable infrastructure for our internal product teams, taking technical ownership from initial requirements to production. Drive architecture and modernization: Make key technical decisions, improve existing systems, and help teams address performance, scalability, and reliability challenges. Automate and improve delivery: Manage Linux infrastructure using Puppet and scripting, build CI/CD pipelines with GitLab, and work with Kubernetes, Argo CD / GitOps, and Terraform. Ensure reliability at scale: Define service objectives (SLIs/SLOs), improve production readiness, and identify potential issues before they affect customers. Strengthen observability: Improve monitoring, alerting, and troubleshooting using tools such as Icinga and the Elastic Stack. Collaborate and share expertise: Work closely with developers and other engineering teams, share best practices, and contribute to technical discussions and decisions. Support production operations: Participate in the on-call rotation, investigate incidents, and drive long-term improvements. Your Profile 5–10 years of experience in Linux administration, infrastructure engineering, SRE, or a similar technical role. Strong Linux expertise and a solid understanding of infrastructure architecture, troubleshooting, and production operations. Experience taking technical ownership of infrastructure or platforms, beyond day-to-day administration. Hands-on experience with automation and infrastructure tools, ideally Puppet, Ansible, scripting, or Terraform. Familiarity with Kubernetes, CI/CD, GitOps, virtualization, or private cloud environments. Understanding of monitoring, observability, backup, and service reliability principles. A proactive, solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to challenge existing approaches and suggest practical improvements. Good communication skills in French and English. Nice to have: Experience with GitLab CI/CD, Argo CD, Icinga, Elastic Stack, Jira/Confluence, or AI-assisted engineering tools. You don't need to know every tool in our stack from day one. We'll provide training on our internal systems and processes. Your Benefits Executive status Fixed-hours arrangement 5 weeks of statutory paid vacation + RTT €10 meal vouchers, with €5.92 covered by Hornetsecurity 100% coverage of public transportation costs Health and life insurance coverage (Axa) Subsidized sports and wellness programs Access to an inter-company daycare International exchange program Ready to make an impact? Join a close-knit, international team where you'll have the freedom to take ownership, tackle meaningful technical challenges, and help build the next generation of our cybersecurity infrastructure. jobs.title: Propulsion Development Engineer
jobs.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity. We want you as a talented Propulsion Development Engineer to help us in our mission by supporting in the development, manufacturing and testing of the Nyx Earth Propulsion systems. In order to qualify the propulsion systems a multitude of tests will be required spanning from functional tests, cold flows to system level hotfires. This testing will allow for the verification and validation of all the propulsion subsystems. You will be designing test rigs to validate flight design, assembling and lastly performing the testing on the test rigs to provide critical data needed to validate simulation models. You will report to the Propulsion Development Models Principal Engineer. Key responsibilities : In your capacity as a Propulsion Development Engineer, you will be responsible for the on-time and on-cost design, development and testing activities linked to the propulsion sub-systems. Your role will be continuously evolving, but day-to-day responsibilities will include: During the Design Phase; Define and maintain the test objectives and requirements Establish and justify, together with the pressure and fluidic system engineers, the architecture and the design (P&ID, PBS, interfaces) of the models and test rigs Design of thruster test rigs Define and select components, parts and sensors and manage their procurement Elaborate and maintain the schedule and cost, ensuring on-time and on-cost of the pressure system and the propellant feed system test rigs. Create test procedures ensuring safe and efficient operation of all test rigs During assembly and testing phase Support on the testing and assembly of thrusters Perform assembly, troubleshooting and commissioning of the test rigs Perform test campaigns, analyzing in real-time the test parameters and the test results with timely resolution of any anomaly arising during testing. Conduct pre-test and post-test reviews and elaborate the test report. Support on updating and correlate the fluidic models based on test results. Perform maintenance and upgrades of test rigs What we would love to see from you: A minimum of a bachelor's degree in a related Engineering discipline. Over 2 years of related experience in designing, building, and testing complex fluid systems. Strong engineering fundamentals in fluid dynamics Proficiency in conducting fluid analyses using classical hand calculations Experience with CAD design Experience using data acquisition equipment, as well as test instrumentation and control components. Experience with the generation of test plans as well as planning and conducting development test campaigns. Experience in cold flow test operations of pressurization and feed systems Excellent collaboration skills for working effectively across departments. Fluency in English. Skills and Behaviours: Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong analysis and problem-solving skills. Strong organizing and prioritization of tasks. Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done. Ability to communicate at all levels of the business. Demonstrates behaviours consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork. Space enthusiast, ready to change the European space industry. Why you should join us! What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is: We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge? We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity empl

jobs.title: 3D & Visual Content Artist
jobs.description: About Alta Ares Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them. Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development. About the Role Alta Ares is looking for a multidisciplinary 3D & visual content artist with strong expertise in video production, photography, post-production, and 3D design. The ideal candidate combines technical proficiency with a strong creative vision and is capable of managing the entire visual production process, from concept to final delivery. Responsibilities Plan and execute professional video shoots and photography sessions. Handle video editing, color grading, compositing, and post-production. Create high-quality 3D assets, environments, animations, and photorealistic renders. Integrate CGI, motion graphics, and visual effects into live-action content. Develop visual concepts and contribute to the creative direction of projects. Ensure high production standards across all visual deliverables. Candidate Profile Strong proficiency in professional camera systems, lighting, and cinematography. Advanced knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, and/or DaVinci Resolve. Advanced 3D expertise using Blender, Cinema 4D, Unreal Engine, or equivalent software. Solid understanding of 3D modeling, texturing, lighting, rendering, and animation. Experience with CGI integration, compositing, and motion design. Strong attention to detail, creative autonomy, and technical problem-solving skills. Please submit your CV and a portfolio or showreel demonstrating your experience in video production, photography, and 3D creation. jobs.title: Field CTO, Southern Europe
jobs.description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The role The Field CTO role is one of Mistral's senior external technical voices; a role for someone who has earned genuine credibility in the AI field and can engage enterprise boards, CIOs, and CTOs as a peer. You will shape how strategic accounts think about their AI strategy, represent Mistral at major industry events, and publish thought leadership that reflects a real point of view on where AI is going. You will work closely with regional sales leadership across your territory and bring what you learn from executive conversations back into Mistral's product direction. This is an externally-facing, influence-driven role. The output is measured in relationships built, content published, and executive conversations that move. What You Will Do Executive engagement Run Mistral's Executive Briefing Center with your regional VP; a selective program for C-level stakeholders at strategic accounts. Build and sustain trusted-advisor relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and VP Engineering across your territory. Thought leadership Publish regularly: articles, whitepapers, and analysis of where enterprise AI is heading. Brief Gartner and Forrester on Mistral's roadmap and market position. Track frontier research and bring it into customer conversations. Conference and event presence Represent Mistral at major industry events through keynotes, panels, and roundtables. Build a public presence that generates inbound interest from enterprise executives and the wider AI community. jobs.title: Customer Care Associate
jobs.description: Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system. The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data. At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day. As Customer Care Associate , you will own customer issue resolution end to end and ensure distributors receive fast, reliable support in their day to day operations. You are accountable for ensuring customer order flow stays running and resolving customer issues as they arise. What you’ll do Own customer issues from first contact through resolution across French and Spanish-speaking markets Build and deliver fast, reliable support workflows used by distributors in day-to-day operations Work through messy, time-sensitive issues (order errors, blocked accounts, product problems) to keep operations running smoothly Make decisions that directly impact customer satisfaction, retention, and order flow continuity Improve support quality by identifying patterns in recurring issues and driving root-cause fixes Take responsibility for clear escalation and coordination with internal teams when needed Coaching and training of external agents supporting Choco customers Collaborate with external support agents and internal teams to maintain high-quality service standards What you bring 1+ years of experience in customer support or operations in fast-paced, tech-enabled environments, with a track record of owning outcomes Comfort operating across multiple tools and stakeholders in ambiguity and high-pressure situations Strong judgment in prioritization and real-time problem solving Accountability when things go wrong and the drive to resolve issues fully Native level of French speaking & writing is required Fluency in Spanish and English (C1+ written and spoken) Working hours This is a customer-facing operational role with fixed coverage requirements. You will work Monday to Friday from 9:00 to 18:00, including a daily upaid lunch break. You must be consistently available during these hours to support customers across both Choco and Goot. What you get Work on digitalizing core operating systems for food distributors, automating orders, sales and payments in a system that still largely runs on calls and spreadsheets. Work with an AI product with proven product–market fit, already embedded in distributor workflows and directly affecting order accuracy, speed, and margins. Join a global team across 6 countries and 40+ nationalities, building a company that has raised $300M+ and reached unicorn status (~$1.2B valuation) with the ambition to define this category end-to-end. In return, you get real ownership, equity, and the support to do your best work, including competitive compensation, health and wellbeing support, and long-term benefits like a sabbatical (all localized by office). Collaborate with people who want to own outcomes in a messy, real-world system and make it work at scale. If you want to work on real problems, take ownership, and raise the bar, we should talk. Choco is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. We are committed to ensuring that our technology is available and accessible to everyone. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are looking for a Rocket Engine Injector Modelling and Design Tool Development intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse. About the role We are looking for a motivated engineering intern to join our Combustion Devices team and contribute to the development of engineering tools supporting the design and analysis of liquid rocket engine injectors. During this internship, you will work on computational tools to automate and accelerate the preliminary design and assessment of injector configurations. Your work will focus on three main areas: Injector layout & manifold modelling: develop tools to automate injector element layouts and associated fuel and oxidiser manifolds, based on geometrical, fluid-dynamic and engineering design rules. Injector spray-pattern visualisation: develop a qualitative visualisation of spray/jet directions, cone angles, spatial coverage and interactions between neighbouring injector elements. Face-plate thermal assessment: contribute to a physics-based methodology to assess thermal loads based on injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle, injection conditions and combustion behaviour. Key Responsibilities Review existing injector design methodologies, engineering rules and relevant technical literature. Develop algorithms for automated injector layout and fuel/oxidiser manifold generation. Implement engineering models and methodologies in MATLAB and Python . Develop an injector spray-pattern visualisation tool. Develop preliminary models to assess injector face-plate thermal loads. Use relevant parameters such as injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle and injection/combustion conditions. Define relevant CFD analysis needs and interpret available CFD and experimental data. Validate models and tools against available analytical, numerical, experimental or literature data. Document methodologies, assumptions, limitations and recommendations for future development and integration into the Combustion Devices design process. What you need to be successful Final-year student or recent graduate in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Software Engineering , or a related technical field. Strong programming skills, particularly in MATLAB and Python . Good understanding of: Fluid mechanics Thermodynamics and heat transfer Numerical methods and computational modelling Experience with data processing, numerical analysis or scientific computing.

jobs.title: Lead Acquisition B2C
jobs.description: Green-Got en bref Green-Got est une alternative complète et moderne aux grandes banques, du paiement à l'investissement. En finance, on ne construit pas à côté du système. Nous y prenons du pouvoir pour en changer la direction. Ce que nous refusons : nous excluons strictement l'expansion fossile, sur tous nos produits. Et notre assurance-vie et notre PER, c'est zéro financement d'entreprise dans le pesticide. Ce que nous dévoilons : ce que les banques traditionnelles font de l'argent de leurs clients. Et nous sommes transparents jusque sur nos propres limites. Ce que nous construisons : les paiements de nos membres financent des enquêtes, du lobbying et du plaidoyer qui s'attaquent aux causes. Les banques ont des lobbyistes ; nos membres en ont un aussi. Quelques repères : Plus de 3 milliards d'euros déjà passés par les comptes et les cartes de nos membres 150 M€ d'épargne sous gestion 15 millions d'euros levés auprès de notre communauté, à chaque fois en un temps record Pourquoi ce poste compte autant. Chaque compte ouvert envoie un message aux grandes banques : le marché a changé. Et plus nous grandissons, plus nous pesons. Notre ambition est assumée : devenir un actionnaire qui pèse au conseil des entreprises qui freinent la transition. Nous commencerons une fois le cap du milliard d'euros d'épargne franchi. Entre nos 150 M€ et ce milliard, il y a ton travail. Le poste Tu prends en main toute l'acquisition B2C haut de funnel de Green-Got : faire venir de nouvelles personnes sur notre app, et les amener à ouvrir un compte ou à investir. Tu as deux grands objectifs : les ouvertures de compte (compte + carte de paiement) et la collecte (investissement). Notre north star, c'est l'ARR : ce qui compte, c'est ce que tu rapportes vraiment à la boîte, pas le nombre de clics. Tu ne pars pas de zéro. Nos canaux existent et tournent déjà. Ton job : les reprendre, les améliorer, les scaler, et en inventer de nouveaux. Le budget que tu pilotes se compte en centaines de milliers d'euros. On cherche un doeur, pas un stratège qui délègue. Tu mets les mains dans le cambouis, tu testes, tu shippes, et tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi lancer. Ce que tu vas faire Site et trafic : tu es autonome sur le site. Landing pages, SEO, GEO, CRO, A/B tests. Acquisition payante : Google Ads, Meta et autres réseaux sociaux. Ciblage, créas, landing, tests, optimisation, toujours pilotés par le chiffre d'affaires final. Affiliation : tu trouves, négocies et pilotes nos partenaires. Tu contrôles ce qu'ils font, tu mesures ce qui marche vraiment et tu arbitres le budget, sans tout miser sur un seul levier. Budget et rentabilité : tu répartis le budget entre les canaux selon ce qu'ils rapportent, et tu le réorientes quand il le faut. Tracking : tu t'assures que tout ce que tu lances est mesuré correctement. Tu peux te faire aider sur la partie technique. Opérations avec l'équipe Wealth Management : tu lances avec elle les opérations sur nos produits d'investissement. Nouveaux leviers : tu imagines et testes des canaux auxquels personne n'a encore pensé. Une personne, des agents IA Pendant des années, une règle a joué contre nous : pour rivaliser avec une banque, il fallait ses effectifs, ses agences et ses milliards. Cette règle vient de tomber. L'intelligence artificielle ne récompense pas la taille. Elle récompense les organisations alignées, rapides et capables de décider. C'est l'asymétrie du renard, et pour la première fois elle joue pour nous : elle nous permet d'avoir dans dix ans l'impact que nous devions avoir dans cent. Pendant ce temps, les quatre grandes banques françaises portent 260 milliards d'euros d'actifs fossiles, et chaque mois que nous perdons est un mois qu'elles gagnent. C'est pourquoi tu seras une personne autonome, épaulée par un agent IA pour chaque canal (site, GEO, affiliation, ads…). jobs.title: CFO (Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung)
jobs.description: Das Universitäre Zentrum für Zahnmedizin Basel (UZB) vereint Patientenbehandlung, akademische Lehre und Forschung unter einem Dach. Mit rund 300 Mitarbeitenden, rund 100'000 Behandlungen pro Jahr und einem Umsatz von ca. CHF 40 Mio. erbringt das UZB seine Leistungen unter anderem auf Basis von Leistungsaufträgen mit der Universität Basel und dem Kanton Basel-Stadt. Wir suchen eine oder einen CFO mit überzeugenden betriebswirtschaftlichen und finanziellen Kenntnissen. Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung ist neben dem Finanzwissen auch unternehmerisches Denken und Handeln gefragt, um das Unternehmen gesamtheitlich zu steuern und weiterzuentwickeln. Ihre Verantwortung Sie verantworten die finanzielle Führung des UZB – von der Budget-, Liquiditäts- und Finanzplanung über das Rechnungswesen und die Rechnungslegung nach Swiss GAAP FER bis hin zum Controlling – und stellen ein aussagekräftiges, stufengerechtes Reporting an unsere Leitungserbringer, die Geschäftsleitung und den Verwaltungsrat sicher. Sie sichern die Finanzierung und Liquidität, entwickeln das Risikomanagement und das interne Kontrollsystem weiter und sind Ansprechperson für den Prüfungsausschuss des Verwaltungsrats und die Revisionsstelle. Sie führen und entwickeln die Bereiche Finanzen (rund 10 Mitarbeitende), IT (3), Technischer Dienst (3) und Einkauf mit vier direkt unterstellten Führungspersonen und fördern die Zusammenarbeit über Fachgrenzen hinweg. Sie bringen die Digitalisierung und Weiterentwicklung von Abläufen und Systemen voran und entscheiden bei der laufenden Evaluation einer neuen ERP-Lösung massgeblich mit. Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung tragen Sie auch die gesamtunternehmerische Verantwortung mit und bringen sich in Fragen der Unternehmensentwicklung aktiv ein. Sie beraten die CEO und die Geschäftsleitung als Sparringpartner in allen betriebswirtschaftlichen Fragen und erarbeiten Business Cases für neue Angebote und Projekte. Sie schaffen Entscheidungsgrundlagen für den Dialog mit internen und externen Anspruchsgruppen in einem öffentlich-rechtlich geprägten Umfeld und pflegen den Kontakt zu den relevanten Stakeholdern. Ihr beruflicher Hintergrund Sie verfügen über substanzielles Know-how in Finanzen und Controlling sowie über Erfahrung in einer verantwortlichen Finanzführungsfunktion. Sie haben einen (Fach-) Hochschulstudium in Betriebswirtschaft abgeschlossen oder sind Expertin bzw. Experte in Rechnungslegung und Controlling; Erfahrung mit Swiss GAAP FER und SAP ist von Vorteil. Sie haben Führungserfahrung, sind es gewohnt bei Entscheidungsprozessen mitzuwirken und anschliessend die Entscheidungen in ihrem Verantwortungsbereich konsequent umzusetzen. Sie kommunizieren differenziert und transparent, arbeiten pragmatisch und verbinden finanzielle Sorgfalt mit Offenheit für neue Lösungen. Sie verfügen über stilsichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. Sie interessieren sich für Digitalisierung und einen verantwortungsvollen Umgang mit Daten und neuen Technologien. Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen oder in einer öffentlich-rechtlichen Organisation sind willkommen, doch keine Voraussetzung. Was die Aufgabe auszeichnet Das UZB ist eine dynamische Institution: 2016 gegründet und seit 2021 um rund 30 % gewachsen. Unsere Strukturen, Prozesse und Systeme lassen sich aktiv mitprägen. Sie verbinden eine finanzielle Schlüsselrolle mit der Möglichkeit, die Weiterentwicklung einer Unternehmung mit gesellschaftlichem Auftrag aus Geschäftsleitungsperspektive mitzugestalten. Build agent runtimes and orchestration frameworks supporting specialized agents for vision quality, predictive maintenance, and operations planning. Experience as an early-stage engineer at a venture-backed startup, contributing to products and systems from zero to one. Strong background in AI and machine learning applied to physical-world systems. Hands-on experience building multimodal AI pipelines that combine computer vision with structured operational data. jobs.title: Senior Manager Account Management
jobs.description: About the Role Account Management is where DataSnipper grows. Our EMEA Accounting AM team manages a book worth tens of millions in ARR across the region's leading audit and accounting firms, and we believe that book can double. The growth won't come from renewals that run themselves. It will come from moving customers onto our AI and Agents platform, defending against cheaper point solutions and free AI tools, and handling firms that keep acquiring each other. As Senior Manager, Account Management – EMEA, you'll lead a team of 5 Account Managers, report to our EMEA Sales leader, and own retention, expansion and forecast accuracy for the region. This is a player-coach role in spirit. You'll be in the deals and in front of senior partners and executives, not managing from a dashboard. Why DataSnipper The best commercial opportunities don't come around every day. Selling technology that's transforming an entire industry is one of them. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. That frees professionals to focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Today, more than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on our platform, and in 2025 alone DataSnipper delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to its customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, we've built a strong foundation for what's next. And as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast. For our commercial teams, this is where things get exciting. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer | Finance
jobs.description: Jij zorgt dat AI niet bij een financiële pilot blijft, maar helpt in het echte werk. Een slimme AI-demo maakt indruk. Maar pas als analisten en medewerkers er elke dag mee werken, wordt technologie waardevol. Zeker in finance, waar betrouwbaarheid, controleerbaarheid en regelgeving nooit bijzaak zijn. Als Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer ben je erbij vanaf het eerste gesprek. Je brengt "we willen iets met AI" binnen weken terug tot een use case die je kunt testen, of je zegt eerlijk dat het (nog) niet kan. Daarna ontwerp en bouw je de oplossing en breng je hem live in cycli van dagen. En dan maak je jezelf overbodig. Wat ga je doen? Je slaat de brug tussen business en techniek: je zit aan tafel bij de klant, ontwerpt de oplossing en implementeert vaak ook zelf. Use cases scherp krijgen: samen met business development voer je discoverygesprekken, toets je use cases aan echte data en systemen en bouw je in dagen een proof-of-value. Ontwerpen en uitvoeren: je ontwerpt de agentic architectuur, kiest per situatie het patroon dat past en brengt de oplossing in korte cycli naar productie, samen met onze AI Engineers. Overdragen en meten: de klant kan de oplossing zelf draaien, en na go-live meet je of hij echt gebruikt wordt. Dát is je maatstaf. Ons slimmer maken: wat je leert, maak je herbruikbaar voor de volgende klant, en je helpt nieuwe FDE's op weg. Ongeveer 10% van je tijd gaat naar pre-sales en 90% naar delivery; business development is commercieel eigenaar. Van KYC tot complexe financiële processen Je kent de werkelijkheid achter KYC/AML, klantacceptatie, klachten- en schadeafhandeling, financiële rapportage, risk en compliance. Denk aan: KYC-dossiers die agents voorbereiden met herleidbare bronnen, zodat analisten sneller onderbouwd beslissen. Documenten en signalen die samenkomen voor een klachten- of schadeteam. Rapportages die nu handwerk zijn, geautomatiseerd binnen de kaders van DORA en de EU AI Act. Wat breng je mee? Aantoonbare ervaring in finance: je kent de processen, data, systemen en risico's van binnenuit. Je hebt AI-oplossingen met LLM's en agents ontworpen, in productie gebracht én onderhouden, inclusief evals, guardrails, monitoring en security. Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric. Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren. Ervaring in een klantgerichte rol, zoals consultancy, pre-sales, solutions engineering of je eigen startup. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Mooi meegenomen: ervaring met DORA, model risk management of audit trails, en met klassieke ML zoals fraude- en risicomodellen. Wat dit níet is Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je. Geen PoC-kerkhof. We bouwen om te gebruiken. Geen slides zonder code. Je advies komt met een werkende versie. Geen agent omdat het kan. Soms is de simpelste oplossing de beste, en dat zeg je dan. Het team Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak. Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen. Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen.  Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt. jobs.description: 24-40 uur per week | Utrecht | Hybride | € 600,- stagevergoeding | Wo-bachelor/-master Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot Waterbeheer heeft wonen, werken en leven in Nederland mogelijk gemaakt. Dat systeem is over honderden jaren opgebouwd en ingericht op een gematigd klimaat. Met zeespiegelstijging, droogte en zware neerslag lopen we nu tegen de grenzen aan. Drinkwaterbedrijven luiden de noodklok over leveringszekerheid en piekbuien wisselen af met extreme droogte. Water is bepalend voor waar we kunnen bouwen, werken en leven. Om weerbaar te worden moeten we andere keuzes maken over de inrichting en het gebruik van onze leefomgeving, waarbij functies beter aansluiten op de draagkracht van het water- en bodemsysteem. Elke dag worden er nieuwe ruimtelijke keuzes gemaakt, bijvoorbeeld over woningbouw, bedrijfsuitbreiding of het energiesysteem. Om daarin meer rekening te houden met water en bodem moeten de wereld van water en bodem en de wereld van ruimtelijke ordening beter samenwerken en elkaars taal leren spreken. Daarvoor bestaan al instrumenten, methoden en werkwijzen, zoals Omgevingstafels, de Watertoets, blauwe omgevingsvisies en water- en bodemsysteemanalyses. Maar werken die instrumenten ook echt, en wat is er nodig om ze beter te laten aansluiten op de praktijk? Dat zoeken wij uit. Wil jij aan het begin van jouw loopbaan direct meewerken aan onderzoek dat bijdraagt aan de koers van Nederland? Bij Berenschot werk je in een dynamisch team van adviseurs op het gebied van water en ruimte. Je krijgt de kans om jezelf te ontwikkelen én tegelijkertijd maatschappelijke impact te maken. Dit ga je doen Jouw onderzoek: Je maakt een inventarisatie van bestaande en nieuwe, innovatieve instrumenten en methoden, en/of je formuleert succesfactoren voor één specifiek instrument (een best practice). Samen met jou en je begeleiders bepalen we de precieze afbakening. Je onderzoek is onderdeel van het project Kwartiermaker water- en bodemsysteemanalyses (Interprovinciaal Overleg en het ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat). Mogelijke resultaten zijn een bijdrage aan de analyse en toolbox van het kwartiermakerschap, een publicatie over best practices, of een instrumentenkoffer voor waterschappen, provincies en het ministerie van IenW. Je bent daarmee onderdeel van het kwartiermakerverhaal, maar blijft niet bij één project. Voor je onderzoek kun je ook putten uit andere lopende trajecten van ons team, zoals het Deltaprogramma Ruimtelijke Adaptatie (DPRA). Daar spelen vergelijkbare vragen over hoe je samenwerking tussen overheden en regio’s echt werkend krijgt. Zo haal je extra inzichten en praktijkvoorbeelden op en zie je hoe verschillende dossiers elkaar versterken. Analyseren en schrijven: je voert interviews uit, analyseert beleidsdocumenten en schrijft mee aan rapportages en publicaties. Initiatief nemen: je werkt mee aan inhoudelijke kennissessies en netwerkevenementen om het watercluster van Berenschot op de kaart te zetten. Hier kom je terecht Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. jobs.description: WE CANNOT PROVIDE VISA SPONSORSHIP Details Preferred starting date: ASAP Weekly availability: Full-time (5 days/week) Period: 6 months Location: Aerospace Innovation Hub, Delft, the Netherlands About the company Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Currently, we are developing software for advanced onboard UAV situational awareness in military applications. Using low-cost and widely available sensors and compute, our solutions are built for scalability. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety. Our team consists of engineers who are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members come from different backgrounds such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics, and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub on the TU Delft campus in the Faculty of Aerospace Engineering. We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low-TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment. The project Sensor calibration is a manual job today, and it does not scale to the number of sensor units we intend to ship. We are building automated test and calibration infrastructure to fix that, starting with a cell built around a UFactory UF850 robotic arm on a linear rail. We already have the arm and the calibration software. What we do not have is the physical cell around it, or the software that drives it. This first project is split into two internships that run side by side: • Robot programming and automation — this position • Mechanical design and integration — separate posting The two interns will work closely together. Neither half of this project is any good on its own. This calibration cell is the first thing we are building on this front, not the last, so there is a good chance the right person carries on to other robotics and automation projects once it is running. Your role If you are the kind of person who is not satisfied until an automated system actually works reliably, not just once, this internship is designed for you. We are looking for a Robot Programming & Automation Intern to help build the software behind our robotic test and automation infrastructure. Your first project is turning a robotic arm on a linear rail into a system that reliably captures good calibration data — but the skills involved are the same ones we’ll lean on for whatever we automate next: getting a robot to move well, knowing whether the data it’s collecting is any good, and building something solid enough to run unattended. Getting that right is the substance of this internship, on this project and on whatever comes after it. What you’ll do • Build the robot control layer: drive the arm through its SDK, coordinate the linear rail, and plan safe motion inside a cell that also has a target, cables, and an operator in it. • Design pose generation that’s actually informed by the calibration problem, including getting proper coverage across a multi-camera rig rather than just one lens at a time. • Get the timing and synchronisation right between the robot, the cameras, and the captured data — this is where automated rigs usually go wrong. • Gate data quality at capture time, and retry within the run rather than finding out later that a dataset is unusable. • Close the loop with our existing calibration pipeline: feed it data, read back its results, and use that to decide what to capture next and when a run is done.

jobs.description: Meet the team    You’ll join the Traffic Control Features team within TomTom’s Automated Driving organization . The team builds the technology that turns real-world observations into reliable map information about traffic signs, traffic lights, stop lines and road markings .   You’ll work with applied scientists and software engineers to develop algorithms and machine-learning solutions that detect, position and connect these features to the right roads and driving directions. The goal is to deliver accurate, scalable map content that supports navigation and advanced driving experiences. TomTom measures these features using quality dimensions such as recall, precision, and road-relation accuracy.   What you will do: Develop algorithms and ML solutions for traffic signs, traffic lights, road markings, and other traffic-control features, including projects with Computer Vision and Image Recognition. Design and productionize solutions that extract reliable map information from diverse, large-scale and noisy real-world data sources, including car sensor data and unstructured information. Improve how features are detected, positioned, and associated with the correct road/lane and driving direction. Drive measurable improvements in recall, precision, and overall map quality against customer-facing targets. Own components of production pipelines, from input data and feature extraction through evaluation and validated map output. Solve complex problems involving geospatial geometry, map matching, computer vision, image recognition, noisy observations, ground-truth quality, and large-scale evaluation. Run experiments, translate successful approaches into production solutions, and clearly document outcomes. Use AI tools, such as Claude Code, to support problem solving, data analysis, implementation, and engineering productivity. Mentor junior colleagues, provide insightful code reviews, and contribute to hiring.   What you will need: 4+ years of professional experience in Applied Science, Machine Learning, algorithm development, computer vision or related field. Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Geospatial Science, Statistics or another quantitative field. Master’s or PhD is a plus. Strong fundamentals in  algorithms and machine learning , including model development, evaluation, statistics and experimental design. Proficiency in  Python , an ML framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, and large-scale data processing tools such as Spark or Databricks. Experience taking algorithms, ML models or data pipelines from experimentation into  production . Experience leading well-scoped technical projects and mentoring junior colleagues. Ability to work across data, algorithms, modeling, ground truth and evaluation rather than operating within only one area of expertise. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently approach complex and ambiguous problems. Proficient written and verbal communication skills in English. You already live in the Netherlands. We cannot offer relocation for this role.     What we offer A competitive compensation package, of course.   Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning.  Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities.   Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location. Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allo

Our bots are lifelike, social creatures that can interact wherever people are online—across voice, video, and text. Create yourself, imagine someone new, or choose from thousands of characters to share infinitely scalable, personalized content and seamless group chat. If you’re excited about how AI can shape creativity and social interaction, come help us build what’s next. About the Role: We’re looking for a Research / ML Engineer to join our Speech Team to build state-of-the-art speech systems end-to-end—from data specs through production inference. You’ll drive the model ↔ data ↔ eval flywheel for TTS and adjacent tasks (voice cloning, controllable TTS, voice conversion and more), partnering closely with research, data, and infra to ship fast, reliable, and cost-aware models. In this role, you will work at the intersection of cutting-edge research and practical engineering, contributing to the development of safe, steerable, and trustworthy AI systems. What You’ll Do: Model Building: Architect, implement, pre-train, fine-tune, and post-train/alignment (e.g., GRPO/DPO) for large-scale speech models. Project Leadership: Independently lead small research projects while collaborating on larger team initiatives. Experimental Design: Design, run, and analyze scientific experiments to advance our understanding of the models. Tool Development: Develop and improve dev tooling to enhance team productivity. Full-Stack Contribution: Contribute to the entire stack, from low-level optimizations to high-level model design. Data Ownership: Define data requirements and collaborate on acquisition, curation, augmentation, labeling quality, and synthetic data strategies. Rigorous Evaluation: Design automated objective/subjective evaluations—listening tests, SV/WER/ASR-based metrics, robustness & bias checks, and red-team studies. Pipeline Delivery: Harden the training → evaluation → inference pipeline; profile latency, memory, and cost; and meet production SLAs with robust monitoring and rollback. GPU Scaling: Partner with infrastructure to run distributed training/inference on cloud fleets and productionize models with reliability and observability. Safety & Responsibility: Contribute to safety/consent guardrails and to misuse/abuse mitigation for responsible speech technology. What You’ll Bring: Exceptional research/development experience with large scale audio models (>3B models and >500k hours data). Exceptional understanding and hands-on experience with transformer architectures and/or diffusion models (inc. distillation and streaming) and/or audio language modelling. Strong experience with multi-node and multi-gpu distributed model training. Strong software engineering skills with a proven track record of building complex systems Strong with PyTorch and performance work (profiling, CUDA/Triton/C++ as needed) and writing reliable production quality code. Shipped large scale speech/audio models to production. Background in working with large-scale ML data. Ability to iterate on data,, and triangulate quality using subjective and objective signals. Notable publications and/or open source contributions in speech/audio/ML. Experience with voice-cloning, speech-control, voice-generation. Preferred Experience: Shipped large scale speech/audio models (TTS/VC/ASR) to production. Work on large-scale ML systems. Experience with audio language modelling, transformer architectures. Experience with voice-cloning, speech-control, voice-generation. Background in processing large-scale ML data. Publications or notable open-source in speech/audio/ML. Compensation: When determining compensation, a number of factors will be considered, including skills, experience, job scope, location, and competitive compensation market data. Benefits for U.S.-based roles: Competitive salary and generous company equity Medical, dental, and vision

jobs.description: Senior/Staff Machine Learning Data Scientist In Brief We’re an early-stage startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives. TLDR : Independent end-to-end model development with ability to work cross-functionally with Clinical, Engineering, and Product to clarify and prioritize specifications and features for our life-saving AI models. Who We Are Bayesian Health’s mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point-of-care. We’re a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, machine learning experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data. We’re funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association’s venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Our company has won many awards; most recent recognitions include: Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, BioTech AI Company of the Year. In practice, that means you aren’t afraid to get your hands dirty by writing data mapping code, debugging a specific patient case by following patient data as it moves through our AWS services, or improving the timeliness of your model’s predictions by reading and writing production-grade Python and SQL code. Responsibilities Model Prototyping: Develop and tune innovative, new ML models and labeler systems based on deep understanding of clinical use cases and state-of-the-art ML methods Productionizing: The same models that you develop with production-grade Python Deploying: Identify strategies for improving our production ML-based systems, and write, debug, and deploy production-grade Python code to implement those strategies Cross-Functional Alignment : Data Science for storytelling – understand model performance and metrics, and present this to technical and non-technical users, both internally and externally Minimum qualifications Ph.D. in a relevant field plus 3+ years experience shipping ML based software products Experience owning your ML models from prototyping to production, especially real-time algorithms that update dynamically across time Experience writing production-grade Python and SQL code to implement and evaluate ML models in production systems Track record of using statistics and performance metrics to compare end-to-end ML and product performance Preferred qualifications Experience shipping breakthrough or 0-1 products from end to end, interpreting and leveraging State-of-the-Art methods to do so Experience using messy clinical and health data to design new products for large Health Systems Experience with any of the following: PyTorch, PySpark, HL7, FHIR, EHR, time series data, signal processing, MLFlow, anomaly detection, Bayesian statistics, quantile regression, time-series forecasting You bring passion and enthusiasm to your work, and are excited to join a growing team to Get Stuff Done and save lives!
