jobs.title: Strategic WFM Analyst
jobs.description: About Clipboard Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S. Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities. Role Overview The Strategic WFM Analyst lives in the Core Workforce Management (WFM) Planning & Operations Strategy team and is responsible for owning centralized forecast, capacity planning, workforce cost optimization, and strategic headcount trade-offs across all lines of business (LOBs). Moving beyond traditional scheduling and intraday monitoring, this role acts as a high-judgment governance function, translating complex demand forecasts into defensible FTE, BPO, and overtime spend strategies, modelling capacity risks, and aligning executive stakeholders across Finance, Product, and Operations. You are exceptionally strong in WFM maths and financial analytics, exhibit deep strategic curiosity, navigate messy raw data effortlessly, and communicate recommendations with executive-level clarity. What You’ll Do Translating multi-LOB demand forecasts into monthly and quarterly capacity, headcount, and budget requirements. Modelling workforce and financial trade-offs across internal FTEs, BPO partners, overtime spend, bonus hours, productivity shifts, and shrinkage. Analyzing demand-funnel changes (e.g., product feature roll outs, AI bot deflection shifts) and quantifying their exact capacity and dollar blast radius. Partnering directly with Finance, Product, and Operations to validate baseline assumptions, enforce input SLAs, and align on staffing commitments. Drafting concise, decision-ready executive memos and Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs) for Directors and leadership. Conducting deep-dive root-cause analyses whenever operational actuals deviate from capacity plans and establishing corrective action paths. Standardizing capacity planning frameworks, modeling templates, and operating standards across LOBs. Maintaining deep forecasting competency to audit models, challenge underlying assumptions, and provide seamless coverage across the broader central WFM engine. What We’re Looking For Strategic WFM Maths: Exceptionally strong quantitative background with deep expertise in WFM fundamentals (capacity modelling, Erlang, shrinkage, AHT, SLA/ASA trade-offs) and advanced proficiency in Google Sheets, SQL, or Python. Business & Financial Judgement: Demonstrated ability to connect operational queue dynamics directly to dollar exposure, hiring velocity, BPO costs, and SLA risk. Executive Communication: Superior strategic writing skills with a natural instinct to distil complex, multi-variable workforce analytics into scannable, 1-2 page decision memos. Cross-Functional Influence: Proven ability to establish governance frameworks, challenge bad assumptions with back tested data, and align Finance, Product, and Operations leadership without formal authority. Blank-Page Ownership: High comfort operating in ambiguous environments with incomplete data, verifiably isolating what materially matters without requiring step-by-step direction. WFM Analyst Profile: Strong core WFM domain expertise with a strategic/Ops spike, not a generalist and not a passive traditional scheduler. jobs.description: Role Description This is a critical leadership role at the intersection of data science, data engineering, finance, and AI. As Director, Data Science & Data Engineering for Finance, you will lead a small, high-impact team that enables Finance to make better decisions through trusted data, robust analytical systems, applied modeling, and increasingly AI-powered capabilities. You will manage two direct reports: a data scientist and a data engineer. Together, the team supports the financial organization across recurring business operations, driver-model maintenance, knowledge coordination, analytical insights, and the development and operationalization of AI and machine-learning use cases. The role requires enough technical depth to guide both disciplines, while maintaining a clear focus on business outcomes, reliability, and team growth. You will partner closely with Finance leadership, Engineering, Data, Product, and other cross-functional stakeholders to establish priorities, improve the quality and accessibility of financial data, and shape a forward-looking roadmap. You will be expected to move the team beyond request-driven execution: identifying the highest-leverage opportunities, clarifying the problems worth solving, and creating the operating mechanisms needed to deliver durable impact. This is an opportunity to shape how Finance uses data and AI at a time when the underlying technologies, operating models, and expectations are changing quickly. The successful candidate will bring a growth mindset, a strong background in either data science or data engineering, and the ability to lead effectively across both disciplines. Responsibilities Manage and grow a multidisciplinary team: Lead, coach, and develop a data scientist and a data engineer, creating clear expectations, meaningful development plans, effective delegation, and a strong culture of ownership and continuous improvement. Set the team’s strategy and priorities: Translate Finance and company goals into a focused portfolio of work. Prioritize ruthlessly across strategic initiatives, recurring operational responsibilities, model maintenance, knowledge coordination, and technical debt. Provide technical leadership across data science and data engineering: Guide problem framing, analytical and modeling approaches, data architecture, pipeline quality, testing, monitoring, documentation, and production readiness. You do not need to be the deepest expert in both disciplines, but you must be able to ask the right questions, recognize trade-offs, and raise the technical bar. Advance AI and modeling capabilities: Identify high-value opportunities to apply AI, machine learning, automation, and advanced analytics to Finance workflows. Establish appropriate standards for experimentation, evaluation, interpretability, human oversight, privacy, and ongoing monitoring. Build trusted data foundations: Partner with data engineering and Finance stakeholders to improve source-of-truth datasets, data quality, lineage, observability, documentation, and reliability. Ensure that recurring reporting, driver models, and downstream analyses are based on accurate and well-governed data. Own analytical and modeling outcomes: Ensure the team develops, maintains, evaluates, and improves models and analyses that support financial planning, forecasting, business-driver understanding, and decision-making. Connect technical work to measurable business outcomes rather than treating model delivery as the finish line. Create scalable operating mechanisms: Establish lightweight processes for intake, prioritization, roadmap planning, model and pipeline reviews, incident response, documentation, knowledge sharing, and stakeholder communication. Reduce dependency on individual heroics and make the team’s work easier to understand and extend. Influence Finance and senior stakeholders: Communicate complex data, model, and engineering considerations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Pre

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. LendingTree and its affiliates (“LendingTree”) will not provide or assume sponsorship for employment visas for this position, now or in the future. The Opportunity As a Data Engineer at LendingTree, you’ll build the pipelines, models, and data services behind reporting, analytics, and data science across our lending and insurance businesses. You’ll tackle complex integration and modeling challenges, improve reliability and cost efficiency, and apply practical AI tools to help the team deliver better data solutions faster. How You’ll Make an Impact Build and operate scalable batch and real-time streaming pipelines, ETL/ELT workflows, and database applications across multiple lines of business, with clear plans for schema changes, retries, and recovery. Design dimensional models and reusable datasets for business, analytics, and data science needs. Perform complex data analysis to validate business rules, identify trends and anomalies, and uncover opportunities. Own the reliability and efficiency of your data solutions: automate quality checks, monitor freshness, tune performance and compute costs, and participate in the on-call rotation to resolve incidents and prevent recurrence. Create reusable frameworks and development patterns that improve delivery speed and consistency. Apply automated testing, code review, and repeatable deployments; maintain technical standards, runbooks, and learning materials. Partner with business users and engineering teams to clarify requirements, resolve issues, and contribute to the data engineering roadmap, including platform capabilities, priorities, technical trade-offs, and delivery estimates. Apply AI tools to development, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting. Validate generated code and results, protect sensitive data, and assess whether these tools improve quality and reduce delivery time. Who You’ll Work With You’ll join the Data Engineering team, working with your manager, fellow engineers, and partners in analytics, data science, product, and business operations across Lending and Insurance. You’ll also collaborate with platform and infrastructure teams to manage dependencies, support production services, and turn business priorities into practical data solutions. What You’ll Bring 5+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, including data warehousing, ETL/ELT development, and analytics, with a record of delivering and supporting production solutions. Advanced SQL skills, including writing, tuning, and debugging complex queries and using data analysis to investigate problems. Experience designing data lakes and warehouses on scalable, distributed platforms, with an understanding of batch and streaming integration patterns. Strong dimensional modeling skills and sound data warehousing practices, including defining grain, fact and dimension tables, and how historical changes are represented. Ability to deliver projects with minimal guidance in an Agile team, using testing, version control, documentation, and systematic troubleshooting to build maintainable solutions. Clear written, verbal, and data presentation skills, including the ability to understand business needs and explain findings and technical decisions through documentation, presentations, or dashboards. What Will Help You Thrive You’re curious about the business behind the data, learn new tools thoughtfully, communicate issues early, and share both credit and lessons learned. Experience in any of the following is a plus: Snowflake virtual warehouses, performance and cost tuning, Streams and Tasks, and/or SQL Server. Matillion, dbt, or similar tools for data integration and transformation. Python, C#, or PowerShell for integration and automation; Git/GitLab for collaboration and CI/CD workflows. jobs.title: Senior Revenue Intelligence Analyst | US
jobs.description: Degreed is the leading enterprise learning system for workforce transformation, bringing together everything people need to learn and advance: courses, videos, articles, projects, and real-world skill insights, matched to individual roles, skills, and goals. For businesses, Degreed builds the infrastructure for a culture of learning that attracts, develops, and retains top talent, driving performance at scale. Named to Fast Company's World's Most Innovative Companies of 2026 — alongside Google, Nvidia, and Adidas — Degreed is recognized for its AI-driven approach to closing the human readiness gap and turning learning ambition into measurable impact. We believe learning is the key to unlocking opportunity, and our mission is to discover, empower, and celebrate the next generation of global expertise. Join us in shaping the future of learning and workforce development! About the Role Degreed is hiring a Senior Revenue Intelligence Analyst to own and drive a unified GTM data strategy supporting pre-sales, post-sales, and leadership with analytics and insights to run the business. This is an individual contributor role inside the global revenue operations team, reporting to the head of RevOps. It comes with regular visibility with senior leaders and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact for cross-functional teams. In this role, you’ll drive revenue intelligence and insights with an AI-forward approach, enhancing business outcomes like retention and new ARR and improving our measurement of marketing ROI, forecasting accuracy, and predictive churn signals. You’ll own and build the dashboards and reporting behind important GTM decisions using our newly implemented BI tool (Hex), and tying data and performance back to pipeline, revenue, and retention. You’ll work with product and engineering to keep warehouse data clean and help validate the commercial data underneath it all, including ARR, quotes, order forms, and renewals. Revenue Operations is a highly collaborative, positive team - we value new points of view, share our expertise, ask for help when we need it, and support each other to get the job done. Degreed is also changing how this function works with AI, from documentation to agents, and you’ll play an impactful role in how revenue operations continue to evolve with AI. Key Skills SQL and BI dashboarding: read and write SQL, and build BI dashboards that sales, marketing, and leadership use in regular decisions. Revenue analytics: trace pipeline from top-of-funnel marketing through closed revenue, find where it falls out of the funnel, and explain what the numbers do and don’t show. Executive communication: present analysis to senior leaders, and explain the numbers when they’re challenged. Stakeholder ownership: run conversations with sales, marketing, and finance leaders on your own, without needing direction at each step. Commercial data validation: check ARR, net new ACV, prorated terms, FX adjustments, and quote-to-order form alignment, and flag errors before they reach finance. Data quality: judge whether warehouse views are clean and validated, and work with engineering to fix them when they aren’t. Tool selection: decide when a report or dashboard belongs in Claude, Salesforce, or Hex, and explain the tradeoff. Requirements translation: turn a business need into technical requirements that field operations, system architects, and engineers can build from. Financial fluency: leverage strong working knowledge of revenue recognition principles, gross/net revenue retention (GRR/NRR), forecasting, and CPQ logic. Ability to leverage AI tools and technologies: use AI (e.g. Claude, Gemini, CoPilot) as a partner in your daily work to accelerate QA, contribute to AI-ready documentation, expand our GTM context layer, and automate recurring work. Key Responsibilities Own the GTM data strategy across pre-sales and post-sales motions, so every team works from the same definitions and the same numbers. Build the business-leve

jobs.title: Project Lion - Senior Prompt Engineer - Japan (Remote, Part-Time)
jobs.description: We are seeking a Prompt Engineer to be responsible for the end-to-end technical migration workflow for transitioning templates to LLM autoraters. The role is required to use client’s internal tools to leverage prompt engineering techniques to maximize model performance. Responsibilities: Utilize Automatic Prompt Generation (APG) tools to create baseline prompts for complex parent-child template clusters. Run and supervise Automated Prompt Optimization (APO) tool, review the outputs, and flag when the APO reaches deadlocks or plateaus. Manually draft, test, and refine prompts to navigate complex template architectures, overcome anti-patterns, and handle edge cases where tooling is lacking or broken. Solve edge-case scenarios by designing and refining manual prompts. Monitor shadowbot runs to ensure sufficient disagreements (between human and LLM ratings) are registered, generated, and tracked. Run prompt versions against established gold data to continuously measure autorater quality against the human crowd baseline, calculating accuracy metrics such as F1 scores, precision, and recall. Draft technical launch readiness justifications (Launch Certification Documentation) for final. Requirement: Language Skills : Native fluency in Japanese and fluent in English. Location: Must be based in Japan. Education : Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Doctorate degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Computational Linguistics, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Cognitive Science, or a related analytical field. Prompt Engineering & AI Expertise : At least 4 years' experience as Prompt Engineer. Proven experience tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) for strict, structured outputs, complex classification tasks, and familiarity with chain-of-thought and few-shot learning. Data Analysis : Strong proficiency in identifying error patterns, analyzing model performance, and using SQL or other data analytics tools. Technical Agility : Ability to quickly learn and master proprietary tools with minimal supervision. Communication : Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Optional / Preferred Skills: Familiarity with enterprise-grade LLM interfaces like the Goose API. Experience in AI model evaluation, data science, computational linguistics, or software engineering. Hands-on experience with Automated Prompt Optimization (APO) systems or tuning workflows. Linguistic expertise, including an understanding of semantics and logic. Compensation Additional Information

jobs.description: Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . Reddit is a complex consumer ecosystem where users, content, communities, and conversations interact over time. We are looking for a very senior data science thought leader to shape how Reddit understands and improves that ecosystem for the user / consumer flywheel. This role will define the measurement, modeling, and experimentation strategy for major Consumer questions: how users discover value, form habits, and deepen engagement; how we understand and serve user intent; how content and communities evolve; and how our systems create durable value for users, contributors, communities, and Reddit. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in one or more areas of consumer science, such as: Recommender systems and information retrieval User modeling, personalization, lifecycle, LTV, or optimization Content, community, or ecosystem modeling Knowledge graphs and representations of users, content, and communities Causal inference, experimentation, and long-term consumer measurement You will partner with leaders across Product, Engineering, Research, and Community to turn ambiguous consumer problems into clear scientific questions, durable analytical systems, and decisions that improve Reddit at scale. What you’ll do Set the scientific direction for high-impact Consumer problems spanning discovery, relevance, personalization, user growth, retention, content, and communities. Build a durable understanding of users, their intent, their needs, and the behaviors that lead to lasting value Develop models and frameworks that represent users, content, communities, and their relationships over time for use in systems that operate at scale Determine how to measure consumer and ecosystem health when objectives compete and short-term engagement may differ from long-term value. Set learning agendas and steer experimentation strategy to distinguish durable improvement from temporary metric movement. Build state-of-the-art measurement systems to evaluate heterogeneous effects across user personas, acquisition cohorts, platforms, content types, and community stages, and guide their actionability in production environments Ensure coherence around ecosystem interactions including feedback loops, selection effects, interference, distribution shift, content supply, and other ecosystem risks. Translate complex technical findings into clear product and business decisions. Develop exceptional scientists through mentoring and influence data science org health and direction Requirements Deep expertise in at least one relevant area, with the breadth and curiosity to work across adjacent domains. A deep understanding of how to model and optimize systems involving users, content, communities, and feedback loops. Ability to frame and lead the most ambiguous questions, identify the most important uncertainties, and develop a rigorous path from evidence to action. Exceptional technical judgment across model design, objective selection, validation, experimentation, and production tradeoffs. Experience with deep-learning frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX. Experience working across Product, Engineering, Research, and other partner teams. jobs.title: Lead AI Architect - Data Platform
jobs.description: Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world. The Role We are hiring our first Lead AI Architect to design, build, and run the centralized data and AI platform that powers Banyan. The cornerstone of the work is a centralized data model, a Banyan data lake, that consolidates the data we already have and unlocks safe AI experimentation for our internal functional teams: Finance, M&A, Business Development, and others. This role is modeled on a classical Enterprise Architect role and adapted for an AI-first world. You will set the target-state architecture, choose the patterns we standardize on, write code yourself, and own the result. You will partner with our embedded business analysts and the leaders of each functional vertical so the platform stays grounded in real use cases, not abstractions. This is a player-coach role. You start hands-on. Over time you build and lead a small platform team. What You Will Build A centralized data lake on AWS: the single, governed source of truth for internal Banyan data. Designed for analytics, ML, and AI experimentation. A reference architecture for AI: patterns and building blocks our verticals use to go from idea to safe production: model selection, RAG, evaluation, observability, cost controls. Guardrails that make experimentation safe: data classification, access tiering, sandboxes, audit logging, and clear rules for what can be sent where. A platform team and operating model: the team, standards, and rituals that keep the platform reliable and improving as adoption grows. What You Will Do Define and own the target-state data and AI architecture for Banyan. Make the trade-offs explicit and write them down. Design and build the AWS-centric data lake. Set the patterns for storage, cataloging, query, ingestion, modeling, and lineage. Likely stack: S3, Glue, Lake Formation, Athena, Redshift, Iceberg or similar open table formats, plus Terraform or CDK for infrastructure as code. Stand up the AI experimentation layer: model access via Anthropic, OpenAI and other LLM Establish data contracts, schema standards, naming conventions, and a domain model that holds up as we add sources and acquire companies. Partner with our Senior Business Analysts embedded in Finance, M&A, and Business Development to translate use cases into platform requirements and to unblock their work. Define security, privacy, and AI safety guardrails. Classify data, design access tiering, and set the rules for handling PII, regulated data, and confidential portfolio information. Stay hands-on. Write code, ship infrastructure, run code reviews, and debug production issues. Architects who do not build lose touch. Build the team including vertical aligned Senior Business AI Analysts. Find suitable contractors for data platform engineers, ML platform engineers, and data engineers. Mentor them. Set the bar for engineering quality. Own platform reliability, observability, and cost. Set SLOs, monitor usage, and keep the bill rational as we scale. Represent Banyan's AI and data architecture to our executive team, our portfolio companies, and external partners. First-Year Outcomes A production-ready, governed data lake foundation deployed on AWS, with at least three priority data domains landed and modeled. At least two functional verticals onboarded to the platform with safe,

jobs.title: Project Lion - Senior Prompt Engineer - Portugal (Remote, Part-Time)
jobs.description: We are seeking a Prompt Engineer to be responsible for the end-to-end technical migration workflow for transitioning templates to LLM autoraters. The role is required to use client’s internal tools to leverage prompt engineering techniques to maximize model performance. Responsibilities: Utilize Automatic Prompt Generation (APG) tools to create baseline prompts for complex parent-child template clusters. Run and supervise Automated Prompt Optimization (APO) tool, review the outputs, and flag when the APO reaches deadlocks or plateaus. Manually draft, test, and refine prompts to navigate complex template architectures, overcome anti-patterns, and handle edge cases where tooling is lacking or broken. Solve edge-case scenarios by designing and refining manual prompts. Monitor shadowbot runs to ensure sufficient disagreements (between human and LLM ratings) are registered, generated, and tracked. Run prompt versions against established gold data to continuously measure autorater quality against the human crowd baseline, calculating accuracy metrics such as F1 scores, precision, and recall. Draft technical launch readiness justifications (Launch Certification Documentation) for final. Requirement: Language Skills : Native fluency in Portuguese and fluent in English. Location: Must be based in Portugal. Education : Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Doctorate degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Computational Linguistics, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Cognitive Science, or a related analytical field. Prompt Engineering & AI Expertise : At least 4 years' experience as Prompt Engineer. Proven experience tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) for strict, structured outputs, complex classification tasks, and familiarity with chain-of-thought and few-shot learning. Data Analysis : Strong proficiency in identifying error patterns, analyzing model performance, and using SQL or other data analytics tools. Technical Agility : Ability to quickly learn and master proprietary tools with minimal supervision. Communication : Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Optional / Preferred Skills: Familiarity with enterprise-grade LLM interfaces like the Goose API. Experience in AI model evaluation, data science, computational linguistics, or software engineering. Hands-on experience with Automated Prompt Optimization (APO) systems or tuning workflows. Linguistic expertise, including an understanding of semantics and logic. Compensation Additional Information

Its award-winning products - Performance (affiliate), Creator (influencer), and Advocate (customer referral) - unify every type of partner into one integrated platform. As consumers increasingly rely on recommendations from people and communities they trust, impact.com helps brands show up where it matters most. Today, over 5,000 global brands - including Walmart, Uber, Shopify, Lenovo, L’Oréal, and Fanatics - rely on impact.com to power more than 350,000 partnerships that deliver measurable business results. Your Role at impact.com: Impact.com powers the partnership economy, helping brands and partners grow revenue through a modern SaaS platform used by thousands of companies globally. We're investing heavily in our growth, and this role sits at the centre of how data powers our go-to-market strategy and sales enablement. We're looking for an Analytics Manager to scale our marketing function. This is a senior individual contributor role - we need someone who’s comfortable owning a domain of the marketing analytics portfolio with light oversight. As Marketing Analytics Manager, you'll own the quality, consistency, and strategic impact of the core reporting used by our GTM teams to shape and prioritize multimillion dollar investment decisions. You'll work on a modern cloud stack (BigQuery, dbt, Looker) with strong support from Marketing and Sales teams - who will be your chief internal customers, and Analytics Engineering, who own the data platform and semantic layer you work with and on. Translate vague business questions ("why is pipeline soft in EMEA?") into workable analyses, sell a solution, and manage the delivery process efficiently. Partner with internal customers and engineers to move recurring manual reporting into useful tools that drive decisions which save time and money. Work directly with stakeholders across marketing, sales, finance, product, and customer success to scope what they actually need and design a plan to get them that information efficiently and with the right level of accuracy. Contribute to data collection and modeling conversations where marketing's needs intersect with the broader company data model. What You Bring: 5+ years of business analytics experience in a software or information business. A strong understanding of SQL and working proficiency with Python — enough to do your own analysis end-to-end without needing outside help. A track record of designing dashboards and reports that people use to actually make decisions, and a sense of taste on what makes the difference between decisive reporting and vague reporting. Ability to explain an analysis or technical concept to colleagues in a way that drives action. Comfortable owning a workstream end-to-end with light oversight: you'll get direction on weekly priorities and outcomes, but will be trusted to set your own week and say no to the right things. jobs.title: 3D & LiDAR Data Annotation Analyst
jobs.description: About the Role We’re building high-quality ground-truth datasets used to train and validate perception models for autonomous and operator-assisted machines working in complex, real-world environments. As a Data Annotation Analyst, you’ll work with camera imagery, video, and LiDAR point clouds to create precise labels that help perception systems understand objects, people, terrain, and surrounding environments. You’ll work in specialized annotation tools, following detailed specifications while balancing accuracy, consistency, and production volume. Your Impact Annotate 2D and 3D objects across images, video, and LiDAR point clouds, including vehicles, machinery, people, signage, and environmental features. Create and maintain accurate segmentation, object tracking, pose, and keypoint annotations across sequences. Apply detailed annotation guidelines, including class definitions, occlusion rules, object thresholds, and inclusion/exclusion criteria. Review your work, respond to QA feedback, and maintain established quality and accuracy standards. Identify and escalate ambiguous scenes, sensor artifacts, tooling issues, and gaps in specifications rather than making assumptions. Document data quality and tooling issues with clear details and reproduction steps. Participate in calibration sessions, guideline reviews, and team standups to maintain consistent interpretations. Share observations that help improve annotation guidelines, taxonomies, and edge-case documentation. Success in this role means producing accurate, consistent annotations at the expected volume while helping maintain a reliable, high-quality dataset. What You Bring Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy while performing repetitive, visually intensive work for extended periods. Strong spatial reasoning skills, including the ability to interpret 3D environments and understand object size, position, and orientation. Ability to learn and navigate complex, purpose-built software and become productive with keyboard shortcuts and other tooling features. Experience working in a fast-paced, scaled environment with defined productivity, quality, or accuracy targets. Experience with image annotation GenAI workflows Reliable high-speed internet, a distraction-free workspace, and the ability to work on a company-provisioned machine within a controlled environment. Nice to Haves Associate or bachelor’s degree. Experience with image, video, LiDAR, or 3D annotation tools. Experience with subsurface utility engineering (SUE), construction surveying, surveying, GIS, or other work involving spatial interpretation of physical environments. Experience with AutoCAD or similar type tools Experience in construction, mining, agriculture, industrial operations, or heavy equipment environments. Familiarity with point cloud data, sensor fusion, or camera-LiDAR calibration. Experience working with autonomous vehicles, robotics, or machine perception datasets. We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here . About the Role At Solace, data isn't just about understanding the past; it's about predicting the future. We are a rapidly scaling startup where we work hard, move fast, and wear many hats. The Solace Data Team is looking for a Data Scientist who excels at forecasting, prediction, and machine learning to help us anticipate patient needs and optimize our operations. Reporting directly to the VP of Data, you will have the opportunity to lead high-impact projects that directly influence our strategic decision-making. In this role, you will go beyond descriptive analytics to build the predictive engines that drive our business. Whether you are forecasting operational volume, modeling patient risk, or designing rigorous A/B tests, you will bridge the gap between advanced statistics and practical business application, ensuring our models are robust, interpretable, and impactful. What You’ll Do Build Predictive Models: Develop and refine machine learning models to solve critical business problems, such as predicting patient churn, estimating operational volume, or scoring advocate quality. Drive Forecasting Rigor: Own the development of time-series forecasts that guide our capacity planning and resource allocation. You will help us anticipate "what comes next" with higher accuracy. Design & Analyze Experiments: Lead the design and analysis of A/B tests and causal inference studies. You will ensure we measure the true impact of our product and operational changes. Uncover Deep Insights: Apply advanced statistical methods to complex datasets to find patterns that simple reporting might miss. You will answer the "why" and "how" behind our most difficult questions. Productionize Solutions: Work closely with Data Engineers to take your models from a local notebook to a production environment, ensuring they run reliably within our data infrastructure. Communicate Complexity: Translate complex statistical findings into clear, actionable narratives for non-technical stakeholders. You will be the voice of statistical reason in strategic discussions. What You Bring Statistical Expertise: You have a strong background in statistics, probability, and mathematics (e.g., hypothesis testing, regression analysis, time-series forecasting). Python & ML Proficiency: You are fluent in Python and its data science ecosystem (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels, NumPy). You write clean, reproducible code. Forecasting Experience: You have hands-on experience with time-series analysis and forecasting techniques (e.g., ARIMA, Prophet, exponential smoothing). Advanced SQL: You can write complex queries to wrangle your own data from Snowflake without relying solely on others to prepare it for you. Preferred Masters Degree or PHD: Data Science, Applied Science, or related fields. Data Privacy Awareness: You understand the importance of protecting patient data. You are familiar with best practices for handling PHI and PII and ensuring privacy in your analysis. Startup DNA: You are a self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity. jobs.description: At Instructure , we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers. We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in: The role. We're hiring a Director of Decision Science to build and lead the team that turns Instructure's data into better decisions. You'll own the decision science function: the people, the roadmap, and the standards. Your team will run experiments, build causal and predictive models, and answer the questions that shape our product, pricing, go-to-market, and operating plans. This is a people-leadership role. You'll still be close enough to the work to review a model, challenge a test design, or dig into a dataset yourself. But your main job is making your team's work count, and making sure leaders act on it. You'll sit at the table with product, engineering, marketing, finance, and the executive team. When a decision is expensive, ambiguous, or high-stakes, you're the person who tells us what the data supports and what it doesn't. What you'll do. Build and lead the decision science team. Hire, onboard, coach, and develop a group of scientists and analysts, and own their career growth. Set the function's strategy and roadmap. jobs.description: At Dscout, we’re building the most flexible and powerful UX research platform on the market—trusted by the world’s top brands in finance (JP Morgan Chase, Intuit, Charles Schwab, PayPal), healthcare (Aya, Headspace), consumer goods (Keen, Verizon, Target, Northface), and tech (Google, Amazon, Facebook, Meta, Spotify, AirBnB). Our tools help teams deeply understand the humans behind their products, so they can build better ones. We are expanding our smart and driven team and would love for you to join us. At Dscout, we're building the human-grounded layer that teaches AI to work in the real world and proves it stays aligned there. We are expanding our smart and driven team and would love for you to join us. Dscout AI Training & Evals builds human data and evals that show whether AI works for real people. For ten years Dscout has captured how people behave in real context, with consent and scientific rigor. Dscout AI Training & Evals points that engine at AI: consented human behavior and judgment, turned into the training data, evals, and benchmarks AI teams trust. Models ace benchmarks and still surprise people in the wild. A benchmark says how capable a model is. It does not say whether the model works for the person using it, across weeks, in the mess of real life. That gap is where we work. We serve AI researchers, the product builders who ship alongside them, and the research teams who partner with both. We are a new unit inside an established company: live customers, a mature platform (React, Elixir, Python, Swift, Kotlin; SOC 2 and HITRUST certified), a small senior team, and room to build. We work AI-native. Agents write code, evals gate changes, and we aim to do in months what used to take years. A note from our Chief AI Officer & GM. The hardest AI problems show up when a model meets real people, with their tools, their interruptions, and their goals. Our customers need a partner who can design the answer, build it, and ship it fast. Ground Truth sits where deployment meets research: what we learn in the field shapes the science, and the science shapes what we ship. Come build it with us. Why this seat Work on a problem the field has not solved: measuring whether AI works for real people, over real time. Study something most evals do not have: real participants, doing real tasks in their own context. Own the benchmark. You are founding it, not joining a team that has one. Publish. Methods and benchmarks go to the research community, with first authorship on the benchmark. Join a small senior team with direct access to the Head of AI Research and the GM. This is a research-first role focused on questions where the right rubric, benchmark, or method does not yet exist. You will find the gaps, propose bold directions, and take projects from the first hypothesis through experiments and benchmark construction to publication. You will also build: the science has to run inside live customer programs. What you will do Rubrics and QA science Design rubrics and test whether they measure what they claim: validity, reliability, and sensitivity. Measure how reliable human raters are, and when disagreement is noise versus real signal. Calibrate AI judges against real human judgment, and study when they drift away from it. Build quality signals that put evidence behind every data point we ship. Long-horizon, real-user benchmarks Design Dscout’s first benchmark: real users, in real context, over long horizons. Multi-week tasks across tools, not one-shot prompts. Define the protocol, task design, scoring, and release. Work with our delivery team on fieldwork. Work out how to keep a living benchmark honest over time: drift, contamination, difficulty, and what counts as a meaningful change. Write the paper and own the public release. Human judgment as training and eval signal Study when real-world human feedback improves a model and when it adds noise. Explore how preference and judgment data from representative people differ

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
jobs.description: Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies. This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems. A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality. Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on. You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies. You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines. Key Responsibilities Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness. Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions. Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards. Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues. Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required. Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews. Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work. TELUS Digital AI Community Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. Qualification path Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring. Basic Requirements Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English. Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years. Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs. Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills. Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools. Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer. Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently. High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets Preferred Qualifications Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification. Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems. Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering. Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements. Equal Opportunity All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

Prior SIP/VoIP or contact-center experience is a plus, not a strict requirement. Build fluency in SIP/VoIP and Genesys voice-platform concepts and apply them effectively in your work. Champion engineering best practices for design, code quality, CI/CD, testing, monitoring, logging, tracing, and production operations. Provide technical guidance and mentorship through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on collaboration (individual contributor; no direct reports). Drive continuous improvement in system performance, availability, scalability, fault tolerance, and maintainability across the voice platform. Minimum Requirements 7+ years of professional software engineering experience as a hands-on individual contributor
